interface.longDescription: Blur a user-selected fixed rectangle throughout a short video. Review every frame inline before sharing. There is no automatic face or object tracking; moving subjects outside the rectangle remain visible. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Blur a fixed rectangle in my attached video; help me specify its location.

publication.release_notes: Adds a branded welcome page with editable starter ideas, OpenAI SDK controls, responsive uploads and OAuth configuration. Keeps inline playback, fullscreen, downloads and saved-preview recovery.
